summary: Explore essential capital market operations tailored for bankers. Enhance your expertise with insights on trading, compliance, and risk management strategies.
lede: Capital market operations covers the workflows that support issuance, trading, settlement and post-trade controls. For banking professionals in operations, settlements, treasury, middle office and risk, this course focuses on processing transactions accurately and managing breaks. You’ll practise validating trade capture and settlement instructions, resolving reconciliation exceptions, and building control dashboards and operational reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for banking professionals who support capital market activity and need stronger control over transactions, breaks, and reporting. It fits the daily work of operations, settlements, middle-office, treasury, and risk professionals who interact with trading, issuance, custody, and post-trade control processes.
prerequisites: You need a laptop, a spreadsheet application, and a working knowledge of banking or treasury operations. A basic understanding of equities, bonds, and trade settlement is recommended, and sample cases will be handled through provided templates and guided calculations.
